en: A monochrome, etching-style image depicting a lone rider on horseback holding a banner, traveling along a winding coastal path. In the background, there is a house or small settlement with two tall flagpoles or masts. To the left, a sailboat is visible on the water, with a lighthouse or distant structure on the horizon. The sky is filled with dramatic, textured clouds typical of classical landscape art.
